note: He is a business owner, which satisfies the occupation test on paper, and health is genuinely the area he let go while building the company. Everything else misses. On income he is the clearest negative case in the corpus so far — 'I don't make any money whatsoever', no savings, no monthly surplus, renting out his own apartment and living with his parents because he cannot cover the mortgage. On starting point he is rescue, not good-to-great: 210 lb peak against a lifetime baseline of ~150, still 30 lb out, and he described the trigger as watching himself atrophy rather than wanting to sharpen something already working. That also fails the stated exclusion almost verbatim — the ICP quote says 'it's not like we have dudes who come here who are 50 pounds overweight', and he was 60 lb up. Worth noting against the corpus-level observation: unlike the Stillwater case, this one did not close, and the thing that stopped it was precisely the income criterion.
